cohort: Infants with a gestational age < 32 weeks born between 2013 and 2020.
finding: The incidence of BPD increased from 16.3% in 2013 to 49.4% in 2020, and factors like IUGR, 1-minute Apgar score, surfactant administration, late-onset sepsis, hydrocortisone, PDA ligation, postnatal steroid, and mechanical ventilation (MV) days were associated with severe BPD or death, with MV > 42 days having the highest adjusted odds ratio.
